test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order forming a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. I have seen a great many houses in my time, little and big, new and old, built of stone and of wood, but of one house I have kept a very vivid memory.

B. It was, properly speaking, rather a cottage than a house -- a tiny cottage of one story, with three windows, looking extraordinarily like a little old hunchback woman with a cap on.

C. The cottage was lost to sight among the mulberry-trees, acacias, and poplars planted by the grandfathers and great-grandfathers of its present occupants

D. It had white stucco walls, tiled roof, and a dilapidated chimney.
solution:
```html

The correct answer is '3' i.e. ABDC is the correct order.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The first statement A introduces the author’s experience with various houses and highlights one particular house.

• The second statement B describes the house in more detail, comparing it to a tiny cottage.

• The third statement D continues the description, mentioning its white stucco walls, tiled roof, and dilapidated chimney.

• The fourth statement C concludes by describing the surrounding environment of the cottage.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct order: *A. I have seen a great many houses in my time, little and big, new and old, built of stone and of wood, but of one house I have kept a very vivid memory.*

*B. It was, properly speaking, rather a cottage than a house -- a tiny cottage of one story, with three windows, looking extraordinarily like a little old hunchback woman with a cap on.*

*D. It had white stucco walls, tiled roof, and a dilapidated chimney.*

*C. The cottage was lost to sight among the mulberry-trees, acacias, and poplars planted by the grandfathers and great-grandfathers of its present occupants.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• While forming a coherent paragraph, ensure that the statements logically follow one another and provide a clear and comprehensive description or narrative.

```
